summary.zh: 编写逐页精确到坐标的 PPT 结构描述
summary.en: Author coordinate-explicit JSON specs for slide decks

description.zh: 按统一的 JSON 契约写出每页的版式树，包含元素坐标、样式、层级和可编辑分类，并遵循安全边距与最小字号。适合需要精确控制版面、不接受自动排版压缩文字的场景。
description.en: Writes a per-slide layout tree in JSON with explicit inch bounds, styles, z-order, and editability classes, respecting safe margins and minimum type size. Use it when layout must be exact.
